config.title: Urban Sports Club vs Gym in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: What Urban Sports Club costs in Berlin, how the venue limits work and when a normal gym or a pool subscription is cheaper.

items.q: How much does Urban Sports Club cost in Berlin?
items.a: On 1 October 2026 the Berlin prices were **Essential €45, Classic €75, Premium €115 and Max €165 a month** on a monthly term. A 12-month term costs €39, €64, €104 or €154, and two years €34, €59, €99 or €149.

items.q: How many times can I go to the same venue with Urban Sports Club?
items.a: Each partner sets its own limit for each plan: **daily, 8 times or 4 times a calendar month,** and some venues are not on the cheaper plans at all. Boulderklub Kreuzberg allows 8 a month on Classic, EVO Fitness Rosenthaler Platz only 4. The venue's partner page shows the limit.

items.q: Is Urban Sports Club cheaper than a gym in Berlin?
items.a: Only if you mix activities. If you train at one gym three or four times a week, **FitX at €29 a month or McFit at €29.90** is cheaper than Classic at €75 and has no visit limit. If your week combines bouldering, swimming and classes, Classic usually wins.

items.q: Which Urban Sports Club plan should I choose?
items.a: Pick the cheapest plan that covers your two favourite venues at the frequency you really go. **For most people that is Classic.** Premium only earns its extra €40 when a venue caps you on Classic and you go more often, or when you would book a massage or sauna session every month anyway.

items.q: Is there a swimming flat rate in Berlin?
items.a: Yes. The Berliner Bäder sell **Basis at €30 a month** (two swims a week in Kategorie 2 and 3 pools), **Flex at €38** (unlimited in every pool) and **Plus at €70** (unlimited with a guest). The minimum term is three months. A single 90-minute ticket costs €6 in a Kategorie 1 pool.

items.q: Can I cancel Urban Sports Club every month?
items.a: Yes, on the monthly term you can cancel up to three days before your membership renews, and it ends with that billing month. **The 12-month term is cheaper but cannot be paused or downgraded,** so a monthly plan is the safer first winter.
